convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'JMACandleSign' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all position open/close logic including money management modes.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is valid

other_exits: Historical bar scan: when both buy_open+buy_close or sell_open+sell_close are enabled but no close signal on SignalBar, EA scans backward bars to find the earliest opposing signal to set close flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots at MM value; FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; BALANCE=fraction of balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: When SignalBar=0, the EA recalculates on every tick (no new bar guard). When SignalBar>0, it only processes on new bars. The EA uses a Recount mechanism: if CopyBuffer fails, it sets Recount=true and retries on next tick. The historical bar scan (lines 126-152) searches backward from SignalBar+1 to find a close signal when both open and close flags are enabled for a direction but no close signal was found on the current signal bar. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions likely used as trade identifiers or expiration. LoadHistory is called each tick to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: The JMACandleSign custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a JMA-based candle signal indicator with buffer 0 (down signal) and buffer 1 (up signal). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ which must all be reimplemented. The MMMode enum with 5 margin modes requires careful implementation especially LOSSFREEMARGIN and LOSSBALANCE variants. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) passed to open functions need understanding of their role in the library. The LoadHistory and CIsNewBar classes also need Python equivalents. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are raw integer values - verify whether they are point-based or pips-based and if digit adjustment is needed in the Python version.
